'''Fire troopers''' were [[Imperial soldier]]s of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that were specialized in the use of [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. [[Darth Malgus]] made use of fire troopers during the [[Rim Campaign]], specifically during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]].
